claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + passive_while_attuned family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. The cloak requires a top-level MagicItemRecord type and a mechanics family for always-on passive effects granted while the item is worn and attuned.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_underwater_breathing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Underwater breathing is not a sense (grant_sense covers darkvision, blindsight, etc.) and is not covered by any existing v4 effect atom. It is a distinct physiological capability — the ability to breathe water as air.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed (grant swim speed variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: modify_speed exists in the v4 taxonomy atom inventory but is not surfaced in types.ts Effect types. Even if surfaced, it would need a variant that grants a new speed type (swim) at a fixed value, not just modifies an existing speed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet
